description.value: Leon's Cafe is a Belgian-inspired coffee shop in Surrey specializing in traditional Belgian waffles, freshly brewed coffee, and locally sourced sandwiches and treats. The café cultivates a distinctly European atmosphere and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. It also hosts community events including art exhibitions and bingo days, making it a lively neighbourhood stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at leonswaffles.com is a functioning site for Leon's Cafe, confirming it is open and real. The website explicitly states gluten-free and vegan options are available ('If you are vegan or gluten free, then you've got options!'). A location discrepancy exists: the OSM community field says 'Tsawwassen' but the website address is 104 - 1688 152 Street, Surrey, BC — however, the OSM coordinates (49.0325, -122.8008) are consistent with that Surrey address, suggesting the community label is the inaccuracy, not the pin. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Tsawwassen' but the website address is 104 - 1688 152 Street, Surrey, BC — the OSM coordinates are consistent with the Surrey address, so the community label appears to be the error.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields for address and phone are null.
Website subtitle reads 'Surrey & White Rock' suggesting a possible second location; only one address is listed so it is unclear whether a White Rock location exists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café with confirmed web presence. Vegan and GF options make it a useful stop for cyclists with dietary needs.
